summary: Completed Phase 9 (Shared Corpus Enumeration) and Phase 10 (Flip run-all.sh's Default to Parallel) of the 11-phase gate-framework refactor. Phase 9 added a producer/consumer pair (gate_registry_shared_corpus_build in gate-registry-lib.sh; common_shared_corpus_available/common_shared_corpus_files in common.sh) so verify-deploy.sh enumerates the tracked agent-system/extensions corpus once per invocation and the 6 affected lints each derive their own filtered view, with standalone invocability and the find-based fixture fallback fully preserved. Phase 10 flipped run-all.sh's JOBS default from 1 to auto, preserving --jobs 1 as the byte-identical sequential opt-out, with new pinning test cases. Both phases closed with committed, passing verification (26/26 and 12/12+19/19 new/regression test cases respectively); fixed a real, pre-existing manifest.json registration gap (8 files from this task's own earlier phases never added to provides.scripts) discovered during verification. Phase 11 (redeploy, idle-machine measured before/after, full-gate verification) remains -- deliberately not attempted this dispatch after two bounded attempts at a full verify-deploy.sh/gate-8 run were terminated under heavy ambient contention from concurrently-active sibling sessions in this environment (host load climbed to 12+); Phase 11 is explicitly chartered to redo this properly on an idle host and should not be duplicated here.

artifacts.summary: Phase 9 closing handoff: shared-corpus producer/consumer design, the deep-nesting glob bug caught and fixed, the verified-harmless gitignored-venv scope narrowing.
Phase 10 closing handoff: the JOBS=auto default flip, the manifest.json registration fix, and the disclosed gate-8-full-battery deferral to Phase 11 under ambient contention.
